propositions: close_ticket commits the STATUS event and releases the lock before the signing tail runs, causing a subsequent lock timeout on completion signature append to be unreported to the caller
completion_signature failures raise SigningError and are caught, writing only a warning to stderr while returning a normal success payload with no field indicating the signature was not persisted
the absence of a machine-readable failure marker prevents library, MCP, and CLI consumers from detecting signature loss programmatically

the completion_signature field {signed, cause, error} with closed vocabulary (signed/sign_failed/material_drifted/force_bypassed) must be threaded through _lib_writes.transition, CLI --output json, TransitionResult TypedDict, and transition_result.schema.json to make the loss visible to all callers
the new message must state the close LANDED and only the signature failed, not presenting the lock error as a failed close

exit code remains 0 because docs/exit-codes.md declares the contract frozen; a new code is additive-only in a future release window, and reusing exit 1 would cause agents to incorrectly re-run the transition
